shared_elements: upright rectangular slab or pillar-like form
vertical elongated shapes set within a framed panel (relief figures in A, eroded pillar-like forms in B)
horizontal banding dividing the surface into registers/strata
loose rubble and excavated debris at the base
justification: Both show pale limestone masses in an excavated, rubble-strewn setting, with upright slab-like forms standing in a framed vertical field above a horizontal division, so at the crudest compositional level there is a faint echo. But A is a close, sharply legible carved relief with recognisable animals, a bird, a snake and patterned bands, whereas B is a distant, weathered rock face where nothing figural can be securely read — a difference of scale, resolution and evidence that outweighs the generic material and setting overlap.
